title: Sprint! The Turf Leading to Tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, haa...
I-Instructor! How was that!?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. You ran better than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to show her running on turf to put their worries to rest――
Yet the instructor who came at Bamboo Memory's request remained expressionless.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Instructor! I'm sorry for being so selfish!!
But I really believe I can compete in the Exhibition Meet like this!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...I have seen your capability quite clearly.
As well as your desire to run on turf. However――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
――What about you, Trainer? Do you have the confidence
to let this girl run on turf without leaving her with regrets?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart skipped a beat. Switching to turf in such a short window
was a decision that could make or break a horsegirl's entire career. But――
choice_data_list: She'll be fine. Bamboo can compete on turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――!! Yes!!
That's right, I can fight!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory had already made her choice.
If so, my role was clear.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I am glad for you, Bamboo.
You have found yourself a wonderful partner.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as she had hoped, Bamboo Memory was officially entered
into the 1,600m turf race at the Exhibition Meet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――The day of the Exhibition Meet was struck by foul weather,
but past midday, the rain cleared, giving way to patches of blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I guess it makes sense, but Oguri-senpai had no clue who I was.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai! Good to meet you!
Looking forward to running with you today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're running in this race too? Let's have a good one.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Once today's race is over!
I'm confident you'll remember my name for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――CLANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I'm staying behind Oguri-senpai...!
I wanna break away so bad! I wanna overtake and pull ahead! But...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Don't go too fast, don't rush it, me!
Remember what the Trainer told you!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory, normally an aggressive frontrunner, holds back in the rear!
Is she taking a cautious approach for her first time on turf!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you stop me just now?
I thought I was flying at a great pace right from the start!
choice_data_list: Putting out too much speed right from the start isn't good either.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. So I shouldn't just charge in with a full-power "Waaah!"?
I'm at my most energetic and fastest at the start, though!
choice_data_list: But you took your time with your nail care, didn't you?
But you took your time with your nail care, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, 'cause that's like hot-blooded training too!
Doing it bit by bit every day is what counts――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, wait. Does that go for racing too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's greatest weapon is the explosive power that chases her dreams.
Bide her time, conserve her energy, and unleash it all the moment they let their guard down.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to all that steady, hard work with my Trainer,
I'm able to stand and fight here. That's why...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I've only got one job to do.
Believe in my Trainer, and believe in my dream!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The lead pack remains bunched tight rounding the fourth corner!
Just ahead lies the final straight―― Wait, what's this!?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory breaks out from the outside! What incredible momentum!
She wasn't out of form! She was conserving her energy from behind all along!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I'll reach her, I'll reach her, I'm gonna make it reach!!
I'm catching up―― to my rival!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: TOOOOOHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce gust of wind tore through. Right before my eyes where I stood
watching near the final straight, Bamboo Memory surged past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that single moment, without a doubt――
Bamboo Memory was running ahead of Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Is it the inside!? The outside!? It's slightly on the inside!
Fighting back to seize victory is Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Second place goes to Bamboo Memory by a nose! What an upset!
In third place is――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...! Ahhh, I lost...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...You. Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh―― Ah, Oguri-senpai! Thanks for the great race!!
Wait, did I introduce myself to you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The commentator shouted it so many times, it stuck in my head.
...That was a great race. I want to race you again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!! Of course!!
Absolutely!! Let's definitely run together again, Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory had stayed as cheerful as ever until the meet wrapped up,
but the moment the Trainer's Office door clicked shut, her breath caught in her throat.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trai... ner... ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Unghhh...!
It's so frustrating! Trainer, I'm just so, so frustrated...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Absolutely, sir!!
Will you keep walking this path with me, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave her a firm nod.
We would defeat Oguri Cap in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My journey with Bamboo Memory, who sought fierce battles above all else,
had only just begun, but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Once again, I'll be in your care, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I felt certain that with this much burning passion,
we could incinerate any thorny path ahead of us.
